methodology: Pipeline simulation: verifier.py loaded directly and called with a mock copy_from_env function that writes crafted JSON to a temp file. Four scenarios tested per task: (1) do-nothing — raises FileNotFoundError → score=0, passed=False; (2) baseline — all-zeros/False JSON from setup_task.sh → score=0, passed=False; (3) partial — JSON with partial completion (some criteria met, total < 60) → passed=False; (4) full — JSON with all criteria met → score>=60, passed=True. No Fiji/ImageJ VM required.
notes: Do-nothing=0 (FileNotFoundError). Baseline=0 (all-false JSON). Partial (30 nuclei, no area/summary/overlay) = 55 pts < 60. Full (82 nuclei, all morphometry+summary+overlay) = 100 pts, passed=True.
app: Fiji (Fiji Is Just ImageJ) scientific image analysis
verification_method: export_result.sh writes /tmp/<task>_result.json → copy_from_env → verifier.py reads JSON and applies scoring criteria
